name: IRGC Navy fast attack craft (Zolfaghar / Seraj / Tareq family)
armament: 12.7 mm or 14.5 mm heavy machine gun
light anti-ship missiles or torpedoes on larger boats
protection: Unarmoured GRP or aluminium hull. Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire. Swarm boats are the game's main Persian Gulf naval threat.
visual_notes: Low, sharp planing hull with a small enclosed or open cockpit amidships
Bow-mounted heavy MG; rocket box or missile tubes on the aft deck
Grey or white hull, often with IRGC Navy pennant numbers; operates in swarms of 4-10
Dimensions are representative (Zolfaghar class); Seraj boats are ~12-16 m
